example: import { EditorialPillNav, EditorialPillNavItem } from "@godxjp/ui/layout"; Pokémon
name: EditorialPillNav

props.description: Visible lead text (aria-hidden; the landmark is named).
props.name: label

tagline: A horizontal band of section links (gh#1435) — a site's "browse by game" row: an optional lead label, then `EditorialPillNavItem`s (an icon or a small `"dot"` marker; `aria-current="page"` on the link marks the current one). Scrolls sideways when it overflows. Geometry: `--editorial-pill-*`.
usage: DO put it in `EditorialSection as="div" tone="surface" divider="end"` for a band under the header.
